# Accepted claims

### claim-claim-component-tests
- basis: observed

Checked-in tests cover console domain, dispatch service, router and contract parsing; Python planner capacity and priority, repository/date grouping and serialization; and Java assignment and configuration baselines.

Evidence:
- file: apps/dispatch-console/tests/contracts.test.ts:1-13
- file: apps/dispatch-console/tests/dispatch-service.test.ts:1-12
- file: apps/dispatch-console/tests/domain.test.ts:1-12
- file: apps/dispatch-console/tests/router.test.ts:1-11
- file: workers/route-planner/tests/test\_contracts.py:1-16
- file: workers/route-planner/tests/test\_planner.py:1-23
- file: workers/route-planner/tests/test\_repository.py:1-14
- file: workers/route-planner/tests/test\_serialization.py:1-15
- file: services/fulfillment/tests/com/marketroute/fulfillment/FulfillmentServiceTest.java:1-20
- file: services/fulfillment/tests/com/marketroute/fulfillment/ConfigurationTest.java:1-13
- file: services/fulfillment/tests/com/marketroute/fulfillment/ContractProbe.java:1-28
- file: scripts/check-contracts.mjs:1-34

### claim-claim-console-config
- basis: observed

loadConfig defaults the console depot to NORTH-01 and daily box limit to 40, and rejects a non-integer or non-positive MARKETROUTE\_DAILY\_BOX\_LIMIT.

Evidence:
- file: apps/dispatch-console/src/config.ts:1-16

### claim-claim-console-ui
- basis: observed

DispatchBoard renders route summaries as depot headings with dispatch and box counts, while StatusBadge returns a status-derived span-shaped render value.

Evidence:
- file: apps/dispatch-console/src/ui/dispatch-board.tsx:1-10
- file: apps/dispatch-console/src/ui/status-badge.jsx:1-4

### claim-claim-contract-parity
- basis: observed

The TypeScript parser, Python validator and Java ContractProbe all require or verify the assigned dispatch vocabulary, and the root script compares the Python and Java probe outputs to dispatch.assigned:ASSIGNED.

Evidence:
- file: apps/dispatch-console/src/application/contracts.ts:1-15
- file: workers/route-planner/src/routeplanner/contracts.py:1-27
- file: services/fulfillment/tests/com/marketroute/fulfillment/ContractProbe.java:1-28
- file: scripts/check-contracts.mjs:1-34
